title: MV Custom Event Sprite Position Offset

posts.author: Rai_Asa
posts.body:
Hey guys, I’m looking for a plugin that allows me to manually set the position of a sprite within an event in RPG Maker MV
Problem: I have a large sprite (2x2 tiles), but RPG Maker automatically centers the event on a single tile. This makes my sprite look diagonal/slanted like this
I want the sprite to be aligned(right) on single tile, so it looks like straight line instead of looking diagonal like on the picture. I have both small and large sprites, but the large one automatically align on center so it looks tilted instead of properly positioned.
(the sprite is 2x2 tiles)
Here’s i want it to look like (i designed it on aseprite so i can adjust the object wherever i want) :
Is there any plugin that let my to Offset the sprite’s position inside the event, so I can align it to the left/right instead of always being centered, or allow X and Y adjustments through plugin commands or note tags.
Is there any way to set a custom position for the sprite so I can place it exactly where I want? Maybe through scripts or a plugin? Any help would be appreciated!
Thanks in advance!
